roster.name: Greek Polanski
roster.desc: A self-appointed Greek wrestling epic. Demands dramatic lighting for every headlock.

roster.name: The Man of 2 Holds
roster.desc: Knows exactly two holds. Refuses to reveal the second until the big event.

roster.name: Rudy, from Football
roster.desc: Just wants to get in the match. The locker room has started chanting his name out of habit.

roster.name: One Man
roster.desc: One man. One entrance. One very firm objection to tag-team wrestling.

roster.name: Terrible Towel
roster.desc: A human brawler in yellow terrycloth ring gear. Waves a rally towel like a weapon, then complains when the crowd waves back.

roster.name: Rudy Giuliani
roster.desc: Arrives with a briefcase of fictional wrestling bylaws. Every pinfall is subject to appeal.

roster.name: Pissboy, P.H.D
roster.desc: Defended a thesis on suplex velocity. Insists the announcer say the full qualification.

roster.name: Mike “The Miz” Mizanin
roster.desc: Every entrance is a season premiere. Every opponent is apparently a supporting character.

roster.name: Frost “Cold” Freeze
roster.desc: A silver-haired human striker in ice-blue ring gear. Every catchphrase arrives with an unnecessary weather forecast.

roster.name: Mandy Mouse
roster.desc: A human powerhouse with a mouse-ear headband, painted whiskers and enormous suplexes. Takes being called adorable as a personal challenge.

roster.name: Sweeps McKenzie
roster.desc: Sweeps the hall before bell time. Plans to sweep the championship scene after it.

roster.name: Turtle, From Entourage
roster.desc: Claims to know someone who knows the champion. Keeps asking where the VIP entrance is.

roster.name: “Street Smart” John Smith
roster.desc: Has a plan for everything and the least memorable alias in wrestling history.

roster.name: Katy “Space Taking” Perry
roster.desc: Needs an entire launchpad for her entrance. Her booking requests include more personal space.

roster.name: Cuba Gooding III
roster.desc: Calls himself the third act. Turns every near fall into an awards-season monologue.

roster.name: Carl “Parallel” Parker
roster.desc: Insists his shoulders are always parallel to the mat. Has not considered the implications.

roster.name: Maddox Hatter
roster.desc: Keeps a reserved seat for a teapot. Calls every time-limit draw an unbirthday.

roster.name: Term Life Insurance Plan
roster.desc: A bespectacled human grappler with a briefcase full of policies. Every loss is an exclusion. Every headlock requires a signature.

roster.name: “Nasty Fucker” Charming Friendly
roster.desc: Says please before every cheap shot. Sends handwritten thank-you notes after stealing a win.

roster.name: Jaxxon “Twitter Fingers” Xander
roster.desc: Posts through every loss. Has tried to ratio the referee in real time.

roster.name: The Grinch Who Stole My Heart
roster.desc: A human wrestler in green-and-red holiday gear, green-dyed hair and heart-shaped face paint. Used to steal decorations; now leaves love notes in the turnbuckles.

roster.name: Chad Kroeger
roster.desc: Demands a wind machine for his entrance. Every near fall gets a full guitar-solo facial expression.

roster.name: Freddie Flounder
roster.desc: A human wrestler in teal gear with fin-shaped shoulder pads. Flops magnificently, counters unexpectedly, and treats every rope break as returning to shore.

roster.name: Lemon Tart
roster.desc: A human wrestler in lemon-yellow ring gear with a citrus brooch. A sweet smile, sharp counters and an extremely sour attitude.

roster.name: “Party Animal” Jesus H. Christ
roster.desc: A human ring-robed party host with a halo headband. Wants every comeback to feel like the whole room just got invited.

roster.name: “Funky Tunes and Attitude” David Guetta
roster.desc: Times every strike to an imaginary drop. Once requested a remix of the three-count.

roster.name: Smark Wahlberg
roster.desc: Rates his own matches before the bell. Complains that his opponent is being pushed too soon.

roster.name: The Local Tourist
roster.desc: Has lived three streets away for twenty years. Still asks the champion for directions to the main event.

roster.name: “Fetching” Ted Turnsby
roster.desc: Immaculately groomed. Treats the opposition like disobedient competition at a very exclusive dog show.

roster.name: The Human Houseboat
roster.desc: A large human powerhouse in a captain’s hat and porthole-patterned singlet. Insists every home match is a waterfront property.

roster.name: Holly “Pizza Pocket” Posey
roster.desc: Keeps emergency snacks in an alarming number of pockets. Claims a comeback takes exactly ninety seconds to heat.

roster.name: “Politically Neutral” Ron Toledo
roster.desc: Has no opinion on the championship. Would nevertheless very much like to hold it in a nonpartisan capacity.

roster.name: Cleats
roster.desc: A human striker who carries his prized football cleats over one shoulder. Superb footwork. Treats those boots like the real stars of the show.

roster.name: Terry Pudding
roster.desc: A cheerful human heavyweight in a custard-yellow singlet, carrying a dessert spoon. Never looks balanced. Almost never lands where you expect.
